levels.text: Catching a returning arrow adds a Tailwind stack

name: Tailwind Catch
notes:
If the arrow hits your hitbox on the return trip it disappears and you "caught" it

In game (hwp_ran_ec_tailwind_catch, tested): catching a returning arrow adds a Tailwind stack (needs Gathering Winds).
summary: Catching your returning arrow grants a stack of Tailwind (Gathering Winds).
